attempts.summary: Established an AIDE-based file-integrity baseline for /etc on node1 (Ubuntu 16.04): installed aide/aide-common, confirmed the shipped /etc/aide/aide.conf.d/70_aide_etc rule covers /etc with checksums, initialized the database via aideinit, activated it as /var/lib/aide/aide.db, verified it detects new files under /etc, and confirmed the baseline and daily-check cron job persisted cleanly across a full node restart.
